<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!-- Shared materials and inertia macros (solid box, cylinder along Z, sphere) -->
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro">
  <material name="orange"><color rgba="1.0 0.55 0.0 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="dark_grey"><color rgba="0.2 0.2 0.2 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="light_grey"><color rgba="0.75 0.75 0.78 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="sky_blue"><color rgba="0.3 0.7 1.0 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="green"><color rgba="0.2 0.75 0.35 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="red"><color rgba="0.9 0.2 0.2 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="white"><color rgba="0.95 0.95 0.95 1.0"/></material>
  <material name="prop_blue"><color rgba="0.3 0.6 1.0 0.6"/></material>

  <xacro:macro name="box_inertia" params="m x y z xyz:='0 0 0' rpy:='0 0 0'">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="${xyz}" rpy="${rpy}"/>
      <mass value="${m}"/>
      <inertia ixx="${m*(y*y+z*z)/12}" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="${m*(x*x+z*z)/12}" iyz="0" izz="${m*(x*x+y*y)/12}"/>
    </inertial>
  </xacro:macro>
  <xacro:macro name="cylinder_inertia" params="m r h xyz:='0 0 0' rpy:='0 0 0'">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="${xyz}" rpy="${rpy}"/>
      <mass value="${m}"/>
      <inertia ixx="${m*(3*r*r+h*h)/12}" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="${m*(3*r*r+h*h)/12}" iyz="0" izz="${m*r*r/2}"/>
    </inertial>
  </xacro:macro>
  <xacro:macro name="sphere_inertia" params="m r xyz:='0 0 0'">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="${xyz}"/>
      <mass value="${m}"/>
      <inertia ixx="${2*m*r*r/5}" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="${2*m*r*r/5}" iyz="0" izz="${2*m*r*r/5}"/>
    </inertial>
  </xacro:macro>
</robot>
